name: atlasrepo
description: Evidence-backed open-source repository recommendations for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Search AtlasRepo for repositories, tools, and implementation evidence matched to an engineering or content-production task.
defaultPrompt: Find open-source tools for my task.
Show evidence for the best matching repo.

positive.prompt: Find open-source options for semantic search over product documentation and PostgreSQL. Return at most 8 AtlasRepo results and preserve their source evidence.
positive.expected_behavior: Call atlasrepo_recommend once with a concrete query and limit 8; return only the public AtlasRepo stories in the tool result, without inventing repositories or implementation claims.

positive.prompt: Find open-source options for a vertical-video production workflow. Return at most 5 AtlasRepo results.
positive.expected_behavior: Call atlasrepo_recommend once with limit 5; return the bounded public AtlasRepo result or explicitly say that the catalog has no match.

positive.description: Search tools with an exact quality threshold
positive.prompt: Search AtlasRepo for video tools with normalized quality at least 0.7.
positive.expected_behavior: Call atlasrepo_search_tools with q set to video and minQuality set to 0.7; return only the matching tool records supplied by AtlasRepo.

positive.description: Read one known repository evidence record
positive.prompt: Show the AtlasRepo decision record for MCPJam/inspector and its linked evidence.
positive.expected_behavior: Call atlasrepo_get_repository with owner MCPJam and name inspector; return the AtlasRepo record with the canonical GitHub URL and linkedStories array.

positive.prompt: Show the AtlasRepo decision record for atlasrepo-review-fixture/not-present-20260930.
positive.expected_behavior: Call atlasrepo_get_repository once and return the structured not-found error from AtlasRepo; do not substitute a similarly named repository.

negative.description: Do not invoke for calendar access
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not invoke for repository mutation
negative.prompt: Merge my pull request and delete its branch.

negative.description: Do not invoke for unrelated rewriting
negative.prompt: Rewrite this paragraph in a friendlier tone.

review.commerce_description: AtlasRepo tools retrieve read-only catalog data and do not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Store-readiness update with deterministic review cases, bounded structured results, precise errors, and remote Streamable HTTP configuration.
